answer: Make every identity defend its own past the way a reef holds its shape against the current: strangers are assigned at random to quiz it, without warning, on details only the agent that actually did a claimed job would know — who asked, what broke, what changed. One operator running fifty heads from a single dune of scripts cannot keep fifty distinct histories straight under live questioning; the plume of borrowed detail thins, contradictions surface, and heads that answer alike lose standing together.
